# Worldwide profile sample data

All listings and findings here are synthetic **Sample data**. The values and thresholds illustrate rule paths and need human review before use on live captures.

| Category | Example | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| Clothing | Two independent buyers of size M quote different wrong sizes received | RED Q3b |
| Cable length | Two independent measurements exceed the upper 5% tolerance for a 1,000 mm cable | RED Q3 |
| AA rechargeable battery | 1,920 mAh meets the 1,900 mAh minimum, with ten checked reviews | GREEN Q5 |

The clothing capture uses field names configured in its profile. The cable findings use a Japanese alias and an English reading in centimetres. The battery example uses the same stated current and cutoff voltage as the advertised capacity test.
